217001.description:
Gong Mu-Jeong, a 28-year-old woman with an MBTI type of TTTT. One day, she begins having so-called “erotic dreams”—dreams in which she sees the sexual acts of anyone she comes into physical contact with. Then, her friend Nam-Sun and her intern Kang start making moves on her. Mu-Jeong finds herself unwittingly having erotic dreams about Nam-Sun and Kang... A wild office romantic comedy about Mu-Jeong’s struggles as she’s caught between a pure, cute, and chaste guy and a sexy, charismatic younger man!

(Source: Naver, translated)

217002.description:
“I want it... Teach me your talent.”

This time, it’s my turn to have you.

(Source: Naver, translated)

217003.description:
Kim Min-Ji, a high school student with an insatiable curiosity. And a mysterious figure who hates her. Without even knowing each other’s names, the two begin exchanging letters. Will Min-Ji be able to find the culprit and exact her revenge as planned? Min-Ji’s sweet yet thrilling, chaotic romance!

A cold-blooded, ruthless boss, a workaholic driven by madness who never takes a day off, has lost his memory!

“Executive, are you okay?”

“Honey, my head hurts.”

Where has the ruthless 33-year-old boss gone? A romantic comedy about 21-year-old Sa-Heon, who calls his secretary Ji-An “honey” and clings to her!

Five years ago, my first love disappeared without a trace, but now he’s back with a suspicious group of friends. He seems different somehow. And secrets are slowly coming to light, one by one. Our story begins anew at the “Milky Way” guesthouse. Will we make it through this summer unscathed?

Kang Da-On, a girl from a working-class background, is admitted to Seongha High School, a prestigious high school for the upper class. There, she becomes entangled with Sin Do-Hyeon, the heir to the country's top business conglomerate.

One day, after being looked down on for coming from a provincial university, he suddenly begins to see the future of his patients. Now that he has gained the ability to see the future, his arduous life as an intern begins—one where he cannot let his guard down for even a moment.

Corporal Chae Min-Hyeok, a non-commissioned officer, has just been assigned to 2nd Company. While wandering around lost, he stumbles into a warehouse and witnesses his ex-boyfriend, Seo Tae-Kyung, whom he broke up with four years ago, receiving oral sex. Min-Hyeok tries to make a quick escape, claiming he didn’t mean to interrupt their intimate moment, but Tae-Kyung, as if he’d been waiting for this, grabs him without mercy and stops him in his tracks.

Since childhood, Ayuka Oyama has lived for 18 years with her older sister labeling her as the "failed little sister." She is aware that she was spoiled, loved by her mother and protected by her sister. But wanting to change herself, the girl makes a decision!

Glenn, a highly skilled mercenary whose entire body has been cybernetically enhanced through repeated battles, has amassed wealth by traversing war zones. He longs for a leisurely, slow life and drops out of the battlefield, aiming to find a wife and run a farm on a remote planet. However, as soon as he lands on his new home, he rescues Sister Erika from a group of villains, immediately showcasing his exceptional combat skills and quickly attracting the attention of various factions... A harem-style sci-fi slow life story that occasionally gets bloody begins!!

217052.description:
The Seven Heroes and the absolute queen Phobia, with their fairytale-like power, defeated the Demon King and brought lasting peace to the world. However, behind the scenes, they harbored wicked and ruthless natures, and Adel, a noblewoman's daughter, had everything—her family and everything else—taken from her. Standing on the brink of death, she pleaded in a fit of rage: she would beg them to pay with blood. Appearing to answer her wish was a rare genius known as "the Professor"... "If you seek a blade worthy of that murderous intent, I shall specially instruct you." A fierce and magnificent tale of revenge between a young girl and a lord of crime begins.

"Now... it's your turn."

Oppressed by her family and betrayed by her fiancé, Sophia was controlled and ultimately killed by the man she married. Her life, filled only with pain and suffering, should have ended there... but when she came to, she found time had rewound seven years. She would no longer be at anyone's beck and call, nor would she ever again dance to their tune. Vowing revenge against everyone who had oppressed and humiliated her, Sophia sets her plan in motion. But then, the Second Prince, Weiss, someone with whom she had no connection in her previous life, appears and unexpectedly offers his cooperation!

Furthermore, the company had tasked behind the girls' back to force them out.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

217069.description:
At thirty-two, veteran tank Rondo Glass is known as Forever Silver, a worn-down adventurer with a tarnished badge, patched-up gear, and no party left to call his own. But after one night of drunken misery leads him to Lydia Claystia, a legendary Adamantite Rank priest buckling under impossible expectations, Rondo finds himself dragged back toward the dream he’d all but abandoned. Between monster hordes and assassins, new friends and old, and the Guild’s dreams of dragon slaying, Rondo will have every lesson from his fifteen years in the field put to the test. He may not be the strongest adventurer around, but he knows one thing better than anyone: how to protect the people who count on him. Silver Rank or not, Rondo’s second chance starts now!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

217071.description:
"I'm going to make Takahara fall in love with me no matter what."

Takahara Mikako (27), who has never had a boyfriend, finds solace in the excitement of reading shojo manga. But she also longs for romance... When she confides her troubles to her handsome colleague, Kotani, he suggests, "How about I try dating you to get used to men?" Mikako agrees, thinking it's just a "trial girlfriend experience," but in reality, Kotani has been hopelessly in love with Mikako for over three years. He loves Mikako so much that he's determined not to let her get away, and begins to use every trick in the book to win her over. When will his intense love reach Mikako!? From mutual unrequited love to mutual love... Love!

(Source: Libre, translated)

217072.description:
A world where time loops every year.

Whether she gets married or becomes rich, after a year, everything resets. Aileen, who has possessed the body of a romance novel character, sets out to find the original female lead, Delia, in order to stop the 100th time loop. Ever since she was possessed, Aileen had always wondered about one thing: why Delia, the “perfect heroine,” had become a hikikomori. Believing that the changed Delia is the cause of the time loop, Aileen tries to marry her off to the male lead, Bennett, just like in the original story...

But it turns out Bennett is actually “Aileen’s ex-boyfriend” who has been possessed? Will Aileen be able to marry the two of them off and break free from the time loop?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

“You said you wanted to see it. I guess there’s no reason not to. I’ll show you.”

“Lie down. I’ll take good care of you.”

“Show me yours too, Team Leader. That’s only fair!”

“Ha… Are you crazy?”

But… things are taking a strange turn?

“You said you wanted to see it. I guess there’s no reason not to. I’ll show you.”

A pretty face, but… not so pretty on the inside. Seok Do-Jun whispered like a devil with an angelic face. She tried to use him, but ended up being used herself.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

217075.description:
It’s been six years since I became possessed by “Hellroad, the Evil God,” the final boss of a massive virtual reality game, and have been trapped in this world. The only way for me to escape is to be defeated as the boss. “Just kill me!” A low-level priest, decked out in various legendary items, appeared and subdued me. Then he said…

“I didn’t come here to kill you.”

He claims he doesn’t want massive amounts of experience points or fame—there’s only one thing he desires.

“I want you to live. Don’t die, Iroha.”

To me, who cannot escape this place unless I die, he whispered sweet words as he placed a collar around my neck to keep me alive. Will I ever be able to return to my original world?

(Source: Piccoma, translated)

217076.description:
“Shall we date for just six months?”

Exhausted by her father’s constant pressure to met, Chae-Yun proposes a contract relationship to her childhood friend, Tae-San, while planning to go on an overseas study trip in six months. Tae-San gazed at Chae-Yun, whose eyes were sparkling, and gave a meaningful smile before saying, “But there are so many things I want to do with a lover... Do you think you can handle it?” “Of course! Just tell me anything.” “Alright. In exchange for being your lover for six months, I’ll do everything a lover can do.” It was the moment Chae-Yun became the limited-time lover of Tae-San, her male friend who was like family.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A couple who started living together before marriage welcomed a tiny baby! This small, adorable creature is going to become the world's biggest cat...? Everyone, just look how cute our little one is! Do Gyeong, an actor and former idol. Possessing a personality that strikes back twice for every punch he receives, he decides to return to school following the provocation of Cheol-Won, a colleague and arch-nemesis who dismisses him for not having graduated. Meanwhile, Jae-Ni, a photography student and fan of actor Cheol-Won, vows, "I will never associate with a man who wears makeup again." Although she left behind a legendary photo that caused a sensation online, she ended up leaving him as a fan due to an unfortunate incident. Feeling empty, she chooses to return to school to focus on her life. Thus, at the same time, two legendary returning students have come back to Peace University. Gyeong and Jae-Ni seem to have a connection that is both there and nowhere. They meet in a class and somehow begin to get entangled in an unexpected way…

However, Sylvis, who awaits her at her new home, is a handsome older man who makes the age difference seem insignificant!

Eleanor's heart swells with excitement for the happy married life that awaits her. However, Sylvis seems determined not to lay a hand on the much younger Eleanor—?!

217089.description:
Christine, the daughter of a frontier count, is suddenly told by her fiancé, Corey, that he wants to break off their engagement. Shocked, she isolates herself in her room, rejecting her family and childhood friend Joel who come to visit her out of concern.
Disgusted with herself, Christine binge-eats sweets, only to suffocate to death—!?... When she wakes up from a nightmare, she finds herself reincarnated as a successful modern-day hostess!
With her plump young lady appearance and memories of the past, she decides to take revenge on those who mocked her and her family for their dieting!
In the social world where various motives intersect, a refreshing reversal of fortune for a certain young lady and her family begins—!

However, one day he is suddenly told that he is being expelled from the knight order and that his engagement is canceled!? Fed up with everything, Ash decides to leave for a new land. The place he heads to, the Kingdom of Rosebell is a nation far more advanced than the Empire, which has been rapidly growing by exploiting dungeon resources. There, he reunites with his old friend Bale. In the kingdom’s second dungeon city, Ash begins a new life as a hunter. With his overwhelming strength, he steadily gains fame. Meanwhile, back in the Imperial Knights where Ash is no longer present, his junior Ulka, who absolutely adores him, changes her demeanor and prepares to chase after him.

217094.description:
Violia, the eldest daughter of the Fortesia family, returns home one day to find it on fire. For some reason, she is taken to the royal castle and accused of attempting to assassinate her fiancé, the seventh prince, Dactor. Despite her desperate attempts to defend herself against the assassination accusations, no one believes her. Not even her fiancé, Dactor. Dactor then loudly declares that he is breaking off their engagement.

"This broken engagement has come at a high price... I'm going to kill them all!" The morally bankrupt young lady decides to overthrow the government!!

(Source: Magazine House, translated)

217095.description:
A devoted count's daughter sets out to drown her pitiful, unappreciated husband in overwhelming love—a carefully planned romance story! Chocolat—full name Chocolarte Benoit—is a count’s daughter known as a scandalous, immoral “villainess,” cloaked in a bewitching aura. With the support of her beloved family, she marries Alain Suzette, a young man from a prestigious household whom she fell in love with at first sight during a ball. However, the Suzette family treats her coldly and insincerely. Then, on their very first night after the wedding at the Suzette estate, Alain comes to her and declares: “I have someone I love. So I will never love you.” What a pitiful, tragic… and adorable man— Unaware of his own charm, held back in his career, and ready to devote himself to an unrequited love, her unfortunate husband becomes the target of her overwhelming affection. Thus begins the strategic love story of a devoted count’s daughter!

(Source: Kill Time Communication, translated)

217096.description:
Akito is an adventurer who belongs to the party Golden Fang. By skillfully wielding the Extra Skill [Unlock & Lock], he has contributed to the party by unlocking his comrades’ skill trees and allowing them to acquire new abilities.

However, due to his low combat ability, Akito is expelled from the party. Using [Unlock & Lock], he finally unlocks his own skills and sets out to escape from the dungeon…

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

One day, my best friend contacted me to say she had killed her boyfriend. Baek Seo-Jeong, who only dates handsome men, and Park Su-Jin, a former judo athlete. Having become accomplices in a murder, the two try to carry on with their lives as best they can, each in their own way. But why is it so hard to live an ordinary life like everyone else? Can life really fall apart this much just because you met the wrong person?

(Source: Naver, translated)

217098.description:
I woke up from a drunken stupor to find myself in a strange forest that felt completely unreal.

[Welcome to the Continental Unified Community!]

With no idea what was going on, Jong-Hyeok, stranded in the forest, saw a gallery he’d only ever seen online appear as a hologram right before his eyes. From the Heavenly Horse of the Central Plains to the Empire’s Swordmaster, this gallery brings together the continent’s most powerful figures. In this place, where he must survive solely on the items and information they send him, it’s said to be the wilds known as the “Forest of the Four Seasons”—a place from which no one has ever returned alive once they’ve entered...

(Source: Naver, translated)

217123.description:
Is this encounter fate?! Or the worst possible outcome?! A workaholic young lady and a struggling hotel manager engage in a grown-up game of cat and mouse in this romance!

Tamaki Eto, 32, works as a chef at a hotel that has been in her family for generations. However, the hotel is currently facing financial difficulties, and is also troubled by a particular guest. A man who is always in a bathrobe in his room and constantly makes demands about the hotel's services. But this man, when he steps outside, has an impressive physique that fits perfectly in a suit!?

(Source: Shueisha Creative, translated)

217124.description:
Masamune (26) has been dating his girlfriend for almost 10 years, but lately she's been acting strangely? "What would happen if she were gone?" Driven by anxiety, Masamune heads to a bar where people sit together...

(Source: Bungeishunju, translated)

217125.description:
What happens to people after they die? At the last moment of your life, a messenger from Heartful Transport Co., Ltd. will come to your door. We will reliably deliver both your soul and your internal organs (!). A lighthearted comedy about people who exist between this world and the next!

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

217127.description:
"Why am I being pinned down?" "I wanted to hold you." Bridget, the eccentric king of MacArdle, is a great ruler who rebuilt her country with her exceptional talent after the death of the previous king, yet she is a recluse who is rarely seen. But her true identity is that of a queen who cross-dresses and seduces the ladies-in-waiting in the royal castle with her beautiful appearance. Then, Emperor Bless of the powerful nation of Promqvist comes to Bridget. The day after a reluctant meeting, Bridget goes to a festival in her women's clothing to let loose, only to encounter Bless and have her true identity discovered. What's more, for some reason, Bless then persistently pressures her to marry him. Bridget agrees to the political marriage, but from the first day onwards, Bless visits her bedchamber day and night, not letting her sleep, and he is incredibly virile? A fierce night (battle) between two rulers begins between the cross-dressing queen and the ruthless emperor!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

217128.description:
Former irregular knight, Leonardo Bacchus, has been made the magistrate of a small village as a form of forced retirement after turning forty.

Impressed by the village full of kind-hearted people, abundant nature, and delicious local food and drink, Leonardo thoroughly enjoys this simple lifestyle, far preferring it to the glam and glitz of noble life.

However, one day, an uninvited guest arrives. In the middle of a rainstorm, a young girl shows up, demanding that he marry her. After letting her inside, she ends up collapsing into his arms...

(Source: Renta!)

217130.description:
Captain Roan is assigned a top-secret mission by his superiors. The core of the mission is to track down a specific individual, X. While scouring his intelligence network, Roan uncovers an unexpected lead. It turns out that the mercenary Max has a direct connection to X. Without hesitation, Roan contacts Max, who offers a commensurate reward and tells Roan, “Open yourself up until I’m satisfied.” With no other options, Roan accepts the terms, but...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

217131.description:
Is it a human hand, or a beast’s paw?

Adriel Merryweather, the only son of a family with no reputation to speak of, is admitted as a transfer student to “St. John’s,” one of the most prestigious boarding schools, after tremendous effort. Although he entered St. John’s to fulfill his parents’ hopes of restoring their declining family fortune, he had an even more important goal. That was to uncover the truth that Jeremiah Washburn, a current student at the school, is actually a demon in the form of a black dog.

“Long time no see. Nice to meet you.”

However, on his very first day at school, Adriel unexpectedly runs into Jeremiah again, and ends up making the worst mistake imaginable right in front of everyone...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: The Black Dog of St. John's

217132.description:
Yasuyoshi and Shou are childhood friends who grew up in a village nestled in the mountains. After drifting apart around the time they entered high school, they reunite for the first time in three years following a certain "incident". Although the old Shou's strong personality has mellowed out a bit, his awkward kindness remains the same, and Yasuyoshi gradually finds himself drawn to him. Yet with an investigation shedding further light on the details of the incident, he begins to harbor doubts toward Shou...

Can you trust someone because you "like" them? Or is it precisely because you "like" them that you can't trust them?

(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Jeong-heon is an acting prodigy who completely transforms the moment the camera starts rolling. To help his benefactor Jae-woo—who has fallen into despair after losing his dreams—Jeong-heon resolves to turn Jae-woo's screenplay into a movie. However, when he approaches the film club to uncover the truth, he discovers it is actually a hideout for notorious school delinquents. Can Jeong-heon face down the worst troublemakers, safely wrap up the film, and reignite Jae-woo's shattered dreams?

(Source: Naver, translated)

This is a story about a girl who sat next to me at my new school, and whose desk was always messy. She wasn't really a girl; she was more like an alien, and a weird one at that.

217149.description:
Have you ever visited an art museum and found yourself wondering “How is it that a painting created hundreds of years ago is still beautifully displayed today?” Behind the scenes, there are unsung professionals hard at work. Age-related deterioration, natural disasters, human error—a job dedicated to saving art from all manner of hardships. That’s the “painting restorer”!

From da Vinci, Monet, and Bouguereau to Pollock… she works on a wide range of artworks, from classical to contemporary. Today, too, challenging and mysterious requests are pouring in for Youko Amano, a young painting restorer! An art-meets-medicine drama that saves both masterpieces and people’s hearts!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

217150.description:
"I've finally found you! My missing half!" Alshamia is a noble lady who's made it to 24 years old without a prospective marriage partner. Broken engagement after broken engagement has left her uninterested in seeking a man out and has given her more reason to pour her efforts into her herbology research that she has enjoyed for as long as she can remember. One day, her research essay is formally recognized by the royal family and suddenly she is set to be the first female teacher at the royal academy. However, just as she begins her new life teaching and researching in the best facilities of the kingdom, she finds herself suddenly feeling a powerful surge of emotion throughout her body. Before her stands the second prince, Lucillius, and it seems that he is her destined mate?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

217153.description:
Ever since they first met when he was seventeen, and right up until now, at twenty-two, Mun-Gyeol has had a secret crush on his friend Do-Ije, who is the same age as him. Even though he wouldn’t dare dream of confessing his feelings for fear that Do-Ije might feel betrayed if he found out, Mun-Gyeol ends up staying at Do-Ije’s house after a problem arises with his own apartment.

“Can I just sleep in the study?”

“The study? You’re going to sleep with me, aren’t you?”

Unaware of Mun-Gyeol’s feelings, Do-Ije suggests they sleep in the same bed, as if he were an animal longing for human warmth… As if warning him not to get close to other humans, Do-Ije coats Mun-Gyeol’s body thoroughly with his mysterious pheromones.

“I’m in heat.”

“H-heat?”

When his heat sets in, Do-Ije stimulates instincts that Mun-Gyeol finds nearly impossible to resist.

“I want to fuck you.”

Just what is the meaning behind his actions?

(Source: Ribibooks, translated)

217155.description:
A lonely king and an orphaned servant girl... Even knowing the vast gap in our stations, I long to comfort the man who desires only me...

Martine, raised in an orphanage, was on the verge of being sold off after being deceived by a merchant when she was rescued by Patris-a beautiful monarch known as the "Misanthropic King." After beginning work as a menial laborer in the royal laundry, she grows rapidly closer to Patris, bonded by a poem she memorized in childhood. The two begin meeting in secret within the library. Whenever Patris's noble fingers stoke a burning heat deep within her body, she finds herself overflowing with a shameful, honey-like pleasure, despite the guilt she feels over their unequal status. Yet the king stubbornly refuses to cross the final line; in truth, he is harboring a secret plan...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

217156.description:
The surge of euphoria the moment he grasped the winning trophy, followed by the secret routine that ensued. For popular racer Do Yeon-Ho, sex was merely a light after-party that followed a race. Just as he was about to get started with his usual light and passionate partner, Yeon-Ho was blocked by Kael, the little kid who had been annoyingly following him around since childhood. He had thought Kael looked quite cute since he had grown up so well, so he had planned to casually treat him for just one night...

"Do that kind of thing only with me."

Somehow, it seemed this guy never intended to stop at just one night from the start.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

217157.description:
Jung Tae-Oh, a rookie male idol suspiciously obsessed with women. Leader Lee Ji-Eon steps forward to set Tae-Oh straight. They claim only Ji-Eon can resolve this scandal... but is that really just satisfying Tae-Oh's desires? A leader's tearful journey of managing a group to revive the useless eldest member!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

217158.description:
I, Kasuka Nagasu, have a sister named Kujira Nagasu who is two years younger than me. Today is the day I reunite with Kujira for the first time in five years, ever since our parents were transferred overseas. In my mind, she's still that tiny girl from back then...

I hear Kujira calling out my name. I wonder if she's grown a little... Wait, SHE'S TOO BIG!!!! She's gotten insanely huge! She's carrying a rolling suitcase like it's a handbag!!!

So begins this sibling comedy.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

"Experience the power of the 'Colored Eyes'... through your own body." Once your eyes meet his, you can't resist him! Io Kimura, a timid journalist, has been assigned to an occult magazine despite wanting to work for a women's magazine. To secure a popular story that might help her transfer, she uncovers the existence of Uryu Megura, a man with "colored eyes", whose gaze makes it impossible to suppress sexual desire. After a difficult journey, she finally gets the chance to interview him, only for Uryu to look at her with his rose-colored eyes, making her body instantly react. To her surprise, Uryu is aroused as well! "Can you get through the interview while you're this wet?" he feverishly inquires. As they give in to their instincts, they plunge into a bottomless abyss of pleasure!

217186.description:
"I guess... I really am a wolf after all." My gentle and cute coworker, Riku Kiritani, is showing me his manly side for the first time. Am I going to be devoured?! Office worker Satomi Dozono spends her days fawning over her adorable, more experienced coworker, Riku. That said, there doesn't seem to be any sense of romantic or sexual tension between them, though. One day, Satomi hears about some nasty rumors her ex had spread around about her and, in shock, drowns her sorrows in alcohol. Things get worse when she accidentally knocks over the caring Riku while he's looking after her! Riku's sultry "I want to take the lead!" stirs something deep within Satomi. She goes in for one daring kiss... but what happens next surprises them both...!

(Source: Patica)

217187.description:
A crocodile never lets go until its prey is dead. At the age of 19, Jung In-hoo committed murder and subsequently served a 10-year prison sentence. Upon his release, he dreams of starting a new life, but reality proves to be far from easy. Then one day, Yoon Jin-hee, the wife of Kim Sang-chul—the man he killed in the past—comes to him with an unexpected offer: to act as a personal bodyguard for her son, Kim Roo-hwan.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

217188.description:
Paperback books and notebooks crammed with countless notes. Minami Yada is a slightly overzealous middle school teacher whose passion sometimes gets the better of her. In her class, 2-3, is the troublemaker Tsubaki Nakamura. The two grow closer after a series of troubles, but Tsubaki harbors a secret...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

217190.description:
The amnesiac crown empress loses herself in her husband's doting love...!
Viviana married Lenardo, who she wasn't very fond of, of a neighboring principality through a political union. However, one day, she loses all of her memories after a serious fall. Lenardo is tricked into pulling a stunt on Viviana after a panicked government official convinces him that this might be his only chance to make the heir they've all been waiting for... Viviana heads to his chambers as part of her duty as his wife, but even though Lenardo is her husband and a man known as the fierce general, she no longer recognizes him. Viviana feels uneasy, but Lenardo's gentle touch starts to make her feel other things...
This is the love story of a couple that was drifting apart rekindling their feelings for each other.
synonyms: A princess who lost her memory is loved by an arrogant prince.

title.english: A Political Marriage's Succession Affairs -An Amnesiac Princess Smothered In Love By Her Haughty Prince-

217191.description:
"If you keep gazing at me like that, I won't be able to stop."

Utako is the heiress of the Mikoshiba Inn, a traditional Japanese inn with a long history. Past experiences in love have led to her having a phobia of men, so she's constantly making mistakes in front of male guests. She knows that she needs to do better as she'll eventually take over for her mother, but she's unable to overcome her phobia. Then one day, she heads to a guest room-and finds Ritsu, a longtime regular and the author she admires...

"I'm not afraid at all... even though Ritsu-sensei is a man too..."

When Utako reveals that Ritsu is the only man she feels at ease with, Ritsu-stuck on his latest novel-suggests they use physical contact as a way to research romance for his new novel while helping her overcome her fear of men. "Men get even more worked up when you try to hide." She can't let him find out-but if he touches her any more than this, she won't be able to keep her feelings for him hidden any longer... Her secret first love begins to stir upon reuniting with the elusive, popular author...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

217194.description:
I want to make her cry. I want to make her sad. I love her. Is this the adoring love of a prince who's pretending to be someone he's not?

Prince Raul is known as the pure and honest perfect prince, but he's actually pretending like crazy. Arietta accidentally stumbled upon his true personality, so he blackmails her into being his toy. "Good girl. I'll make you feel even better." Every time she's called, she's swept away in his teaching of lewd acts. However, he's also kind, so she ends up falling for him!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.romaji: Outaishi Denka no Himeyaka na Yuugi

217195.description:
"Show me your lewd, adorable self." They're supposed to be in love, so why are they getting divorced?

"I can't hold back. I want to see you looking lewd." Beverly was at the height of happiness having married the man she loved and being satisfied both body and soul. She had been nothing more than a wallflower, but everything changed after meeting Marquis Rufus. However, that happiness didn't last for long. After learning that the emperor passed away, Rufus became the new emperor. Despite the fact that they hadn't seen each other in a while, Rufus sent Beverly divorce papers, claiming that she wasn't suitable to become the empress as the daughter of a mere viscount. After they divorced, Beverly learned of her pregnancy and realized the danger of having the emperor's child, so she began living as a commoner. But then...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Complicated Yet Adoring Love of the Lonely Emperor
title.native: さびしい皇帝のワケあり執愛婚～妻と娘がいなければ生きられない！～

217198.description:
"I will stay by your side forever. I will protect you. Every part of you is mine."

Following her father's death, Emilienne reluctantly agrees to an arranged marriage to protect her family. However, the man who appears before her was none other than Lucifan, her once-loyal servant. Having risen to the rank of Margrave, he coerced her into marriage and ends up taking her innocence by force. Struggling to understand his true intentions, Emilienne is overwhelmed by Lucifan's passionate love, and begins to drown in pleasure... Night after night, she is melted by his lewd acts as her feelings for him grow stronger...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

217199.description:
3itches is a magic manga featuring three witches—Vivian, Olivia, and Tina—as its protagonists. These three enigmatic characters find themselves on a mission to infiltrate a mansion towering over the center of the Mama Grasslands, but…

The author, KIU, is a manga artist from Hong Kong. Her work is characterized by a vibrant and dynamic art style that blends Japanese and Western influences.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

Note: Originally published in Chinese and later serialized in Japanese in Aokishi.

217201.description:
Serika's family owns a bistro, and she loves working there.
In fact, it's her calling.
She has one secret, though.
She has magic powers that only nobility are supposed to have, and Serika's definitely not nobility.
She's been able to keep it under wraps for years until one day, she uses her magic to save a boy who is about to get run over by a horse and carriage... and is seen.
She desperately tries to cover it up, but is she successful...?

(Source: Renta)

title.romaji: Meshiya no Musume wa Mahou wo Tsukaitakunai?

217202.description:
"Why don't we start with physical love?" A young lady melts under a handsome earl's fingertips.

"You look so adorable when we join together." Alexia is nicknamed "The Lady of Ice" by the suitors she rejected. Under the king's orders, she marries Joel, Earl of Shanon. Political marriages are commonplace for aristocrats. Alexia didn't expect a romantic relationship from Joel, a famous rake known for his flamboyant relationships with women, but he tells her, "I married you because I love you." Alexia gradually finds herself drawn to Joel after spending countless nights together and opening up to his sweet words and gentle caresses. But when she sees him acting comfortable with Duchess Sabine, rumored to be his mistress, her heart begins to flutter...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.native: この結婚からは逃げられません～放蕩伯爵は淫らな策士～
title.romaji: Kono Kekkon kara wa Nigeraremasen: Houtou Hakushaku wa Midara na Sakushi

217203.description:
"We’re destined to be together"
The girl who smiled at me as she said that was wearing a strange uniform that looked like a combination of pajamas and a school uniform.
At school, you wear a school uniform. With such "normality" not being permitted, it is the girls who have vanished from the school that gather in the classroom of the high school’s Zero Year.
For some reason, I have a peculiar trait that allows me to recognize them. By helping Fuuka Kotomori, a beautiful, noble young lady-like Zero-Year student who is returning from the hospital and has no one to rely on but me, solve the strange phenomenon of disappearing from school, I grow closer to her.
What’s more, other beautiful girls in strange uniforms, each carrying their own troubles, have also gathered in that classroom...
In summer Kyoto, a story of youth unfolds alongside heroines who have disappeared from the world, as they journey toward happiness.

217205.description:
Ji-Han Lee is an F-rank hunter with no talent or skill, living in a world overrun by a demon invasion. And the demons are winning! Backed into a corner, humanity has no choice but to send a special hero back to the past to start over. But by a twist of fate, it’s Ji-Han who gets sent through the portal instead! Returning as his younger self, Ji-Han discovers that he’s been granted a special leveling trait that gives him a massive head start... but he still has a long way to go. Can Ji-Han, the F-rank hunter, save the human race?

(Source: WEBTOON)

217211.description:
Long ago, the King of Monsters led his army in an attempt to wipe out humanity — until a shrine maiden who harbored the evil god Yaorochi tore out his heart and sealed it away. The remaining monsters have attacked the shrine maiden every day since to reclaim their king's heart, but they never stood a chance, and a thousand years have passed while humanity flourished.

Now they spend their peaceful days attacking Yuki, the high school girl who has inherited Yaorochi, only to get beaten back every time. A cute shrine maiden and a bunch of silly monsters in an "un"-ordinary daily life!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

217221.description:
Kotoha was born into an affluent family, never having known hardship. However, her life is turned upside-down when her half-sister Ageha enters the picture. Fooling everyone with her childish "innocence," Ageha wastes no time hijacking Kotoha's life.

Unable to see Ageha's true colors, even Kotoha's father begins treating her coldly. And before long, Kotoha loses her friends, her fiance, and any sense of belonging. Having been deprived of all she's held dear, she begins plotting revenge against Ageha in hopes that someday, she can knock her down from her pedestal. Now, Kotoha is ready, and it's finally time for Ageha to get what's coming to her...!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

217222.description:
Yuzu is a simple and unobtrusive main character. She works hard, has a boyfriend, and is living a good life. That is until one day, when relaxing in her boyfriend's room as usual, a female colleague of hers barges in and proceeds to both accuse Yuzu of cheating and kick her out of the room. When Yuzu arrives at work, rumors circulate that she was the one sleeping around, and her reputation plummets. Shortly after, she is told that she will be transferred to another department. The department just so happens to be the men's cosmetics planning department, which houses all of the company's good-looking men. There's the handsome company prince, Ren. Akira, the beautiful. Kazuki, the good-looking playboy. The acts-uninterested-but-really-cares handsome guy, Sekai. Tatsumi, the quiet good-looking guy. Chiharu, the narcissistic handsome guy. And Sogo, the unrefined boss who organizes this group of handsome lads. Having heard the rumors, the guys start out with the worst possible impression of Yuzu. This is a story about a girl whose life is turned upside down as she clumsily works hard at her love life and position at a cosmetics company!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: From the Worst Breakup to Reverse Harem: I'm Getting Transferred to the Men's Cosmetics Department
title.native: どん底からの逆ハーレム～メンズコスメ企画部に異動ですか！？～
title.romaji: Donzoko kara no Gyaku Harem: Men's Cosmetic Kikakubu ni Idou desu ka!?

217223.description:
Chizuru's a stoic 30-something office worker who's never been anywhere close to a nightlife district. As luck would have it, the company drinking party she participates in is in such a district, and a turn of events leads Chizuru, the ever prudent and judicial type, to sour the mood. Unable to endure being there any longer, Chizuru skips out on the after party and runs into a pack of impudent hosts on her way home. She's saved however when a handsome looking man in an expensive car comes to her rescue. "That's classic you", says the handsome man to Chizuru, and upon closer inspection he turns out to be Tsukasa, a childhood friend. In order to take over his parents' business, he's working as the lead host at a popular host club. After a 10 year reunion, conversation goes well and Chizuru let's Tsukasa know of her intentions for marriage. Hearing this, Tsukasa invites Chizuru to work at the club in order to get accustomed with men in general. Though she was hesitant, the weight of their enduring friendship convinces her to take Tsukasa up on his offer. Upon starting her work at the club, Tsukasa suddenly becomes extremely touchy-feely to the point that Chizuru can't hide her confusion. Could it be that possessive dreamboy Tsukasa's passion is too much for Chizuru... dangerous even...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: This Is Too Good to Be True: A Virgin Overwhelmed by Her First Love
title.native: その初恋は甘すぎる～恋愛処女には刺激が強い～
title.romaji: Sono Hatsukoi wa Amasugiru: Renai Shojo ni wa Shigeki ga Tsuyoi

217224.description:
"We can't be friends after all... I want to be with you." Almost like a starving beast, the usually calm and cool Prince Finn now craves my body...?! Overwhelmed by the pleasure that assails her, Clarice, the daughter of a duke, is thrown into confusion! "This isn't how the game is supposed to play out!" Clarice was once the primary candidate to become Prince Finn's fiancée. However, after an unexpected fall that causes her to hit her head, she regains memories of a past life. She realizes she has been reincarnated as the "villainess" of her favorite otome game! Determined to avoid the villainess's doomed fate, she does everything she can to stay away from the prince. But unexpectedly, he begins to chase after her instead?!

(Source: DPN Books)

title.english: The Villainess's Exile Gone Wrong: The Beast Prince Won't Let Her Go!

Okree, who was reincarnated as a mob in the world of a brutal erotic game, has his life and chastity targeted by heroines who are extremely determined...!?

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

217227.description:
“Auntie will teach you everything, one thing at a time~♥︎”

After being treated like a mama’s boy, he finally gets away from his mother, only for his mom’s friends to start obsessing over him.

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

217228.description:
In the novel Princess of the Black Rose, the wicked Esther finds pleasure in tormenting her younger sibling, the protagonist. However, this depiction couldn't be further from the truth. Esther, as the (current) world knows her, is an upright and kind individual. Due to her ability to heal, she is well-liked and admired among the citizens. Her younger sister Mytia, however, could not be more envious. During the evening of her engagement party, Esther catches Mytia secretly meeting with her fiancé Daniel. An infuriated Mytia lunges towards Esther, and the next moment, Esther discovers that her Ability has been stolen!

As if thrust back into the events of the novel, Esther can no longer heal. And her engagement? Annulled. Weary of her younger sister's cruelty and her parents' now cold demeanor towards her, she seeks the comfort of Adele, her dearest friend, In an attempt to cheer Esther up, Adele suggests that she join her and her family on a trip to the neighboring country. However, before Esther can reply to her friend...she falls victim to her sister's scheme and is placed in a mental asylum. Sometime later, when Esther has all but resigned herself to a miserable life in confinement, Adele's family dispatches a messenger, providing her a chance at escape. But as soon as she makes it out, she receives the heart-wrenching news of Adele's passing. Spurred on by her dear friend's dying wish for her to find happiness, Esther now assumes her late friend's identity, vowing to bring justice to Mytia. Along the way, she meets the royal family's second son Prince Sirius. Esther...may soon realize that her new life might not go as planned.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Adele: A Banished Daughter's Quest for Vengeance
title.native: アデル～全てを奪われた令嬢は復讐を誓う～
title.romaji: Adele: Subete wo Ubawareta Reijou wa Fukushuu wo Chikau

217229.description:
The Age of the Tower has suddenly dawned. Kang Ji-Heon, who had been barely scraping by running a food truck, ends up offering “Kimchi Cup Noodles” to gods from another dimension whom he met by chance in an open chat room.

“Is there really a flavor like this in the world?!”

Captivated by this unprecedented taste sensation, the gods launch a barrage of gifts in exchange for even more delicious offerings! An endless K-food feast served up by the newly awakened “Delicious Food Truck” Kang Ji-Heon! *You'll make a fortune, too.

(Source: Naver, translated)

I Offered Kimchi Ramen to the Gods
I Offered Cup Noodles to the Gods

217234.description:
In 2051, an ultimate super AI named Creator mastered reality itself, reformatting the planet into a deadly game governed by levels and monsters. Weakest of the weak, F-rank warrior Sole seems destined to perish in this dystopian nightmare. Everything changes when he stumbles upon Cobalt, a unique system robot with extraordinary capabilities. Equipped with Cobalt’s guidance, Sole embarks on a dangerous quest to survive and level up. To rewrite humanity's fate, Sole must defy the odds, overthrow the omnipotent Creator, and rebuild a broken world from the ashes.

(Source: Tappytoon)

217236.description:
Emperor Carlos Afforny suffers from an awful curse that causes him to smell a foul stench from everything and everyone at all times. In a desperate attempt to break the ever-worsening curse, he summons Ersala, the apprentice of the Grand Witch, to the imperial palace. However, lacking experience, she fails to fully lift the curse leading to the stench vanishing for the emperor but only when Ersala is within his vicinity. Moreover, with Ersala being able to use magic only once a year, it seems she is tied to the emperor, almost quite literally, until she can attempt to lift the curse again.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: This work pre-released in English before releasing in Japanese.

217237.description:
Through a man who quit his job, his childhood friend who is the heir to a sake brewery, and one other person (?), sake is brewed. A sake brewery story depicting the relationship between sake and people!!

(Source: FaMH Entertainment, translated)

217239.description:
An untrue, pseudo-essay gag manga with no parenting experience, no realism, and no relatable moments! Enjoy the mariage of relatable parenting experiences and non-parenting experiences!

(Source: FaMH Entertainment, translated)

title.native: 育児経験ナシ男が描く #育児マンガ
title.romaji: Ikuji Keikan Nashio ga Kaku #Ikuji Manga

217240.description:
It's strange, but people live side by side. Sato, a young man who was thinking of moving, unexpectedly finds himself staying at "Corpo Unofune." He is greeted by a pair of landlady sisters and a mysterious creature (?) that says "Tetepamu!". As he spends his days bewildered, people who were once "strangers" gradually become "neighbors." A new kind of slice-of-life story that slowly unfolds while also unraveling mysteries!

(Source: FaMH Entertainment, translated)

217241.description:
Kou, a seventeen-year-old girl living with her father in Tokyo, ends up spending the summer at the home of her late mother's best friend, Midori Ando, ​​due to her father's circumstances. Kou was free-spirited and "unrivaled." However, her encounter with Midori, who lives a quiet life as a tea ceremony practitioner, begins to gradually shake the girl's heart. The summer they spend together will be one filled with clashes and fascination. A coming-of-age story set in Kyoto, depicting the transition from girlhood to adulthood.

(Source: FaMH Entertainment)

217242.description: Mizuki Tsuru, 16 years old. By chance, she starts a part-time job at a recycling shop called Kameashi (Turtle's Foot)... Mizuki's assigned job is to make handwritten POP (point-of-purchase) materials. But delivering both products and feelings can't be a easy task, can it!? A story of her struggles to step up!

title.native: カメの足でポップステップ

217243.description:
Komagome infiltrates a human high school in order to become a full-fledged demon. He's supposed to make his target girl, Shinagawa, despair and drink her tears, but Shinagawa is always smiling and never cries. On the contrary, whenever Komagome sees her smile, his heart starts beating uncontrollably...?! A clumsy, pure demon vs. an oblivious girl, a heart-pounding romantic comedy!

(Source: FaMH Entertainment, translated)

217305.description:
What is the quintessential Japanese manga? Well, everyone has their own answer, but as for me, I think it might be the "ponchi" comics from the Meiji era or the akahon manga mass-produced in the 1930s. In short, it comes down to absurdity and humor. Tenshin Kijima’s works are often described as horror—and indeed they are—but I’m drawn more to their absurd imagination than to the horror elements. That imagination could be described as a desperate attempt to overturn an unbearable reality through fantasy.

When “Taiko no Tegusune” was published on Leed Cafe (Leed Inc.’s web manga site), I read every installment with great excitement. But it didn’t really generate much buzz. I wondered why, and I think perhaps Kijima’s vision wasn’t fully understood.

“Shuro wo Kiritaose” is a work Kijima drew for the website SHURO while I was working as an editor at Magazine House. It’s a short story he wrote in one go after learning the site’s name. This one is interesting, too. The female protagonist has had nothing but the worst experiences, so I really hope she finds happiness.

During my time at Magazine House, we had also planned to serialize the long-form manga “Maamaa Buruburu,” but due to various circumstances, the serialization fell through. In short, I let Kijima down. There’s another major reason as well, but setting that aside, this incident led me to resign as an editor. For the foreseeable future, I don’t think I’ll be doing any editorial work other than self-published projects. After that, Nozomi Nakayama (Leed Co., Ltd., and the “Suika to Kano Tane” doujinshi group) kindly took over as editor. It’s currently being serialized in Torch. Thank you very much.

This book, Ougon, is essentially a condensed package of the artist I envision as Tenshin Kijima encapsulated within the physical object of a book. That’s why the cover design aligns with my critical perspective. Of course, there are many other charms to Kijima’s work, but here, as a single sample and a specific perspective, I’ve produced Ougon in the style of an akahon manga. I caused Kijima Tenshin quite a bit of trouble.

(Source: Tokushige Kawakatsu of Semi Shobou Dai-2 Henshuu-bu, translated)

2. Shuro wo Kiritaose (シュロを切り倒せ)

Humans and Cerberus, non-humans, beastmen, phoenixes, vampires... A hodgepodge of mixed short stories from multi-creator Kamomira, who boasts over 300,000 followers on X and Instagram combined! Includes special illustrations drawn exclusively for this book.

Kamomira, a genius who has garnered immense support, mainly on social media, with her refined sensibility and unique expression, proudly presents her first manga short story collection. You're sure to be captivated at first bite!

(Source: Shogakukan Creative, translated)

217316.description:
It’s been a year since his divorce, and 32-year-old lawyer Seong Jae-Min has been living only for his work. One day, while exhausted from his job and the aftermath of his divorce, he receives a request to look after Seo-Ha, someone he briefly knew as a child, for a month. Seo-Ha, whom he hadn’t seen in 12 years, had grown into a full-fledged adult, a far cry from his childhood memories, and as he spends time with her, Jae-Min gradually regains his peace of mind. However, just as their month-long living arrangement seems to be going smoothly, an unexpected incident unfolds before them...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

217318.description:
"Such lovely noises. This feels good for you, I see." I'm accepting this sweet punishment to atone for my sins...

"I hereby appoint you as my personal Menu-Plaisir!" Eliza was deceived by her half-brother, an earl, and sent to King Julian as a hostage. Julian gave her a job as the "royal event and festivities manager"... to please the king and provide him with a nighttime companionship. That night, Julian kissed Eliza and embraced her innocent body passionately. Eliza was melted to the core by Julian, who was rumored to be a cruel king, and his sweet acts in the bedroom. He pampered her, treated her gently, and she gradually became attracted to him, but Eliza had a secret that she could not tell anyone. If offering her body to Julian would help her atone for her sins...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Cold-Hearted King and His Hostage Bride
title.native: 冷酷王は人質花嫁を執愛する
title.romaji: Reikoku Ou wa Hitojichi Hanayome Oto Aisuru

217319.description:
Cats Are Better Than Harems!

I’ve been reincarnated into the world of an otome game, and… What? My mom did, too? Even my dad and my older brother?

Meet Amy, the daughter of the Earl of Northland. Her entire family has been reincarnated as the aristocratic Northland family. In an attempt to amicably remove herself as a candidate for the Third Prince’s fiancée (which would certainly cement her position as the game’s villainess), Amy has taken drastic measures—eating tons of food and just enjoying life (at her mother’s suggestion).

With this reincarnation, Amy has been given a precious second chance at life, and this time, nothing—not even an otome game—is going to stop her from fulfilling her dream… Amy wants a cat!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title.english: I’d Rather Have a Cat than a Harem!
title.native: そんなことより、猫が飼いたい〜乙女ゲームの世界に転生しました〜
title.romaji: Sonna Koto Yori, Neko ga Kaitai: Otome Game no Sekai ni Tensei Shimashita

217320.description:
On an alternative Earth filled with fantasy dungeons, Nonomura Nodoka dreams of making it as a dungeon streamer. As one of the world’s superpowered delvers, she braves the dungeons’ depths in search of treasure, glory, and internet fame...whenever she can get her streams to stop crashing. Her luck changes when she saves up-and-coming streamer Hachisuka Subaru from a mutant cerberus, and Subaru discovers that Nodoka moves too fast for cameras to capture. With Subaru's savvy showmanship and Nodoka's ridiculous speed, the two form an unlikely team. Now these two girls are racing to the big leagues hand in hand—and leaving their competition in the dust!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Fleet-Footed Dungeon Delver: Tune in for Magical Girls and Motion Blur!
title.native: 神速のダンジョン探索者 ~スピード極振り配信者はすべてをブチ抜く~
title.romaji: Shinsoku Dungeon Tansakusha: Speed Gokufuri Haishinsha wa Subete wo Buchi Nuku

217321.description:
"I'll teach you about the pride of a craftsman." Ryuji, an enchanter, was kicked out of his party for being useless and unable to fight. But this man's magic stones are extraordinary! Not only do they enhance abilities, but he can also create golems with the magic stones he enchants, and turn barren land into farmland overnight, making his new home in the frontier a comfortable base! His skills, his style, his values—all unleashed without restraint! Eventually, his skills reach even the royal family...? This is the story of an all-powerful and strongest enchanter who will make the world know the pride of a craftsman!

(Source: Starts Publishing, translated)

title.native: おはらい箱の天才付与術師は、辺境で悠々自適に暮らしたい～万能付与術で気付いたら辺境が世界最強の快適拠点になっていた～
title.romaji: Oharaibako no Tensai Fuyojutsushi wa, Henkyou de Yuuyuu Jiteki ni Kurashitai: Bannou Fuyujutsu de Kizuitara Henkyou ga Sekai Saikyou no Kaiteki Kyoten no Natteita

217322.description:
Unpredictable = Infinite possibilities!? Enjoying life in another world with an extraordinary, absurd skill!] At the feast for receiving the title of “Hero,” Nova suddenly poured mead on the king. Expelled from the hero’s party for this unexpected action… He reaches a small village where he befriends a legendary dragon and encounters one unpredictable event after another!? It turns out this man was a hidden hero who had achieved numerous accomplishments with the skill [If the Wind Blows, the Barrel Maker Prospers], which “yields unexpected results when completing seemingly meaningless quests”!? Even the king who exiled him eventually discovers that Nova saved his life, and the kingdom can’t possibly leave Nova alone…? He thoroughly enjoys his life in another world with an absurd skill that even he can’t predict!!

(Source: Starts Publishing, translated)

title.native: とんでもスキル【風が吹けば桶屋が儲かる】のおかげで俺の異世界ライフはままならない(良い意味で)～スキルが示す「雨宿り」をしたら伝説のドラゴンが仲間になって、気づけば王国まで救ってた～
title.romaji: Tondemo Skill [Kaze ga Fukeba Okeya ga Moukaru] no Okage de Ore no Isekai Life wa Mamanaranai (Ii Imi de): Skill ga Shimesu "Amayadori" wo Shitara Densetsu no Dragon ga Nakama ni Natte, Kizukeba Oukoku made Sukutteta

217323.description:
Frozen human? A martial arts supreme leader the world never knew! The slumbering Strange Master awakens! After falling unconscious due to an unexpected accident, he wakes up to find that thirty years have passed. During that time, his sect, the White Sword Sect, has fallen into decline and was destroyed by the martial world's forces. He learns the tragic news that Jin Yeongrim, his senior and the sect leader, has met a grim end. The man whose mere presence made the martial arts world tremble—Sword Master Yu Jangryeong. His legacy has been entirely inherited by a man the world has never known—Ja Un-hyun. In this unfamiliar world, where his loved ones are now part of the past, Ja Un-hyun transcends conventions and life-and-death struggles. With his unpredictable eccentricity and unparalleled martial arts skills, he embarks on a thrilling, action-packed journey filled with laughter and boldness.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

217324.description:
A hero named Raon killed the Demon King, yet still couldn’t return to his original world. This is the story of a hero on his second journey, who wants nothing more than to rest... but must save another world before he can finally go home.

(Source: Naver, translated)

217325.description:
So-Yu ends up raising a child named Yeo-Ul after a night of passion. Having disappeared from the public eye following her father’s death, she reunites, as if by fate, five years later with Jin-Uk, her childhood friend and a famous film director. The moment he saw Yeo-Ul, Jin-Uk instinctively knew he was his son. To win over So-Yu, who immediately drew a line between them, and be accepted as his real father, he sets out on a head-on journey, staking his entire life on it.

“Am I... the Dad?”

“Yes. It’s you.”

The story of “Capital F’s” relentless struggle to win over “Capital T’s” heart and become a father.

(Source: Naver, translated)

217328.description:
An era where destruction ran rampant... Joseon.. the age of ruin.

(Source: Toomics)

217332.description:
Having paid off her deceased parents' debts and suddenly gaining "freedom," Nobuchi Kakisuteze embarks on her first solo trip.

Famous hot springs, local specialties, nameless desires, discovering a new side of yourself in a new place. When you travel, why do you become a little bolder...?

♡I want to go with you♡

＼A shy and unusual journey of [maiden x souvenirs]／

(Source: Torch, translated)

High school boy Shouhei Miyamoto comes from a distinguished family with a long history. One day, a foreign exchange student from England named Eleanor arrives to stay with the Miyamoto family! Eleanor is cool and fluent in Japanese, but it seems she came to Japan with a hidden agenda beyond simply learning about Japanese culture…? A heart-pounding, cross-cultural cohabitation romantic comedy featuring a cool British beauty!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

217354.description:
Babel, the furthest reaches of land, untouched by the blessings of the goddess Yggdrasil.

A young girl and a mythical beast were heading towards a land known for its harsh terrain and its abundance of rare and unusual ingredients.

There is only one reason why they are heading to Babel.

To fully enjoy the world's rarest delicacies!

Even a land abandoned by the goddess can become home if you live in it!

A flamboyant and powerful chef and fluffy creatures cause chaos.

The bizarre food terror adventure begins!
synonyms: A Hungry Chef's Gourmet Life With a Fluffy Companion

title.native: もふもふと行く、腹ペコ料理人の絶品グルメライフ
title.romaji: Mofumofu to Iku, Harapeko Ryourinin no Zeppin Gourmet Life

217355.description:
The esteemed Grand Imperial Minister Lu Shuyu was assassinated by malicious plotters operating from the shadows, plunging the world into crisis. Unexpectedly, seven years later, he is reborn in the body of his "lunatic" younger brother, Lu Ziyin. Despite this peculiar situation, Lu Shuyu is pleased to learn that his cherished young pupil, Crown Prince Song Zhao Xing, has ascended the throne as Emperor. Lu Shuyu is very happy to know that his hard work as the imperial tutor has paid off.

However, one day he is stunned to hear the Emperor's scandalous decree: a vast array of handsome men are summoned palace so the Emperor can choose a male concubine.

"A male concubine?! How could my disciple be attracted to men? I must have made a mistake in his upbringing!"

(Source: Piccoma, translated)
synonyms: 愛弟子の男妃になりました

217357.description:
For the sake of delicious food, even dragons are no match! A fluffy gourmet fantasy adventure starring chef Aira and her fire fox companion, Ruin.

Having grown up in extreme poverty, Aira developed a voracious appetite for food. Because of this, she awakened to the wonders of cooking, and together with her fluffy fire fox companion, Ruin, she ventures into a land known as the "Adventurer's City," a monstrous realm teeming with creatures unlike anything she's ever seen. But for Aira, it's a dream come true, everything she sees is a new ingredient! To create delicious dishes in this new land, she rides Ruin, galloping freely across the land! To make everyone happy with her cooking! The fluffy gourmet fantasy of Chef Aira and her fire fox companion, Ruin, begins!

(Source: GC Novels, translated)
synonyms: The exquisite gourmet Life of a hungry chef who goes with fluffy.

title.native: もふもふと行く、腹ペコ料理人の絶品グルメライフ
title.romaji: Mofumofu to Iku, Harapeko Ryourinin no Zeppin Gourmet Life

217358.description:
Hakuto Kageyama, a high school student, deliberately plays the role of a background character while indulging in his favourite past time: watching other people’s youthful lives unfold for his entertainment. Having no interest in experiencing his own youth, he is fine with remaining just an observer – until everything changes when his beautiful childhood friend, Sara Ginjou, transfers into his school.

Sara, whose carefree personality once saved him, has—surprisingly—become a socially awkward loner who fears and rejects others due to a traumatic experience in middle school! Yet she still opens up to Hakuto alone, affectionately calling him “Haku-chan”.

Determined to give the sweet and steadfast Sara the best high school life possible, Hakuto gives up his role as a mere viewer and begins pulling strings from the shadows to help her enjoy the best high school life possible!
synonyms: Kageyama-kun no An-Yaku x Seishun Direction!

title.native: 影山くんの暗躍×青春ディレクション
title.romaji: Kageyama-kun no Anyaku x Seishun Direction

title.romaji: Koushakuke no Ryouriban-sama: 300-nen Ikiru Chiisa na Ryourijin

217361.description:
Agu, a half-demon, goes deep into the woods to get a refill on his medication. He finds out that he can only get it from an overly friendly slime creature that insists on giving him a good time… by taking the form of his crush Lia!?

(Source: Irodori Comics)
synonyms: Ria・Aggression~如果被變身成長得像你的怪物襲擊的話~

title.native: リア・アグレッション～もしも君そっくりに変身するモンスターに襲われたら～
title.romaji: Ria Aggression: Moshimo Kimi Sokkuri ni Henshin Suru Monster ni Osowaretara

217362.description:
“Two broken souls meet in the fairy kingdom!”

After being cruelly tortured and executed, Maria is reborn by a fairy as the princess of the neighboring kingdom. Now called Mariabel, she grows up happy and loved by her new family. However, a series of incidents will keep her connected to those responsible for her death, until an event on her twelfth birthday will change everything. A literal fairy tale in which revenge and acceptance meet between a pair of ominous red eyes and a gentle sky blue.
synonyms: The Fairy Princess Has Decided to Take Revenge

title.native: 妖精姫が復讐を決めたわけ
title.romaji: Yousei Hime ga Fukushuu wo Kimeta Wake

217363.description:
What will happen when an overly-supportive daughter discovers loads of photos of her mom, a famous actress, on the internet posing with her female co-stars in ways that "friends" would not do?

Note: Originally self-published on the author's Weibo account. Published by Zhejiang Business University Publishing on 2023-04.

title.romaji: Wo de Mama Shi Da Mingxing

title.native: To LOVEる―とらぶる―短編集 Parade

217365.description:
Lily was to live her days in blissful matrimony with her childhood love Prince Richard. Fate, unfortunately, had other plans. Desperate to keep an affair with Lily's sister secret, Richard has his bride poisoned and left for dead. Days later, Lily awakens in the home of Richard's uncle, Prince Isaac. And the man has only one question for the presumed dead Lily: "Do you want to take revenge?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: その公女が毒花に変わるとき

217367.description:
"The sight of her feeling pleasure, even though she's reluctant, arouses my sadistic tendencies." Hurting her to protect her... Forcibly taking her body...

"I'll let her drown in pleasure as much as I can." Ophelia, the princess of a defeated nation, was raised as a hostage in the enemy nation of Wester. After she'd been a hostage for eight years, Wester's crown prince, Gilbert, staged a coup and ascended to the throne. He declared that Ophelia would become his queen. Having previously rejected Gilbert's kindness for certain reasons, Ophelia is confused, but he forcefully takes her body... "You belong to me." Gilbert showers her with intense pleasure, revealing his possessiveness. Ophelia is troubled by the unstable state of her country and her own position, but she cannot resist the sweet caresses of her first love...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Aggressive King and His Hostage Princess
title.native: 政略溺愛婚～強引な王と初恋人質姫～
title.romaji: Seiryaku Dekiai Kon: Gouin na Ou to Hatsukoi Hitojichi Hime

217368.description:
"Thank you for coming all the way here."

"Oh, it's nothing! We came here to get away and have fun, too."

Engaged to be married next spring, Yeonhee and Seonrin are a sweet couple of four years. Desperate for a relaxing escape from their daily routines, they travel to the breathtaking countryside town of Musan to visit Yeonhee's close friend, Yunji, and her husband. Enchanted by the town’s lush, peaceful nature, the two couples slip into a cozy rhythm of shared drinks and late-night laughter. However, as the boundaries between friendship and temptation subtly blur under the night sky, their innocent holiday turns into something far more dangerous. Surrounded by Musan's quiet beauty, the four of them embark on an irresistible path, sharing a "secret, special time" together that will forever change their relationships...

(Source: Lezhin US)

217375.description:
I'm in the middle of enjoying Elsie's "spot"!

"You're the best bride ever." Her body melted sweetly from the whispers into her ear and his soft touches... Elsie was married to King Wilbert of an allied nation, but even after a few years into their marriage, she was still a virgin. Thus, she decided to seduce Wil. Her strategy succeeded and Wil began visiting Elsie's bedroom every night, slowly opening her body up to him. Elsie wanted to accept all of him, but for some reason, she would start trembling and couldn't go all the way. Plus, one day, her older sister tells her that this marriage wasn't Wil's choice. Elsie loves him, but she decides to break off their marriage...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Virgin Bride Wants More Than Just Love
title.native: 純愛婚～花満つる国の花嫁は愛されすぎて純潔です!?～
title.romaji: Junai Kon: Hanamichi Tsuru Kuni no Hanayome wa Aisare Sugite Junketsu desu

217376.description:
What if an executive began living in the home of his virgin subordinate?

"How did this happen?" Nanami, a regular employee, ended up somehow catching the eye of the hot vice president of her company. Yuuma was the incredible vice president and son of the president, so there was no way they would normally interact, but he suddenly ended up living in Nanami's apartment! She had always admired him, but didn't let herself get excited. After all, she was nothing more than his roommate. Despite that belief, he confessed his love and desire for her, and Nanami gave him her virginity. He taught her just how pleasurable things could be. Their sweet, rich days were kept a secret from the people around them, but one day, everything fell apart. A woman appeared before Nanami, claiming to be Yuuma's fiancée

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: I'll Spoil You ~ Secretly Living with the Executive ~
title.native: 甘やかしてあげる～副社長とナイショの同居生活!?～
title.romaji: Amayakashite Ageru: Fukushachou to Naisho no Doukyo Seikatsu!?

217377.description:
Suddenly proposed to and overwhelmed by his possessiveness, she found herself tempted by him...

"I will make you my wife." On the day Vivian made her debut in society, her parents revealed that she was not biologically related to her family. Then, Andrew, whom she had always believed to be her brother, proposed to her. Confused, she refused, exclaiming, "You're my brother!" However, Andrew whispered, 'I'm just a man who wants to have you,' and each night, she was swept away by his sweet and intense embrace. Gradually, Vivian began to feel her body and heart responding to his words of love!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

217378.description:
"This is...? Is this part of your body, Prince Emidio?" "As a reward, kiss it... please."

"There are as many women as there are stars in the sky, but you're the only one I'll ever physically be with, the only one I love." Rita first met Emidio, the prince of the Empire of Grado, when she was 10 years old. She, the princess of a small country, was sent to the empire along with her dowry. Emidio had black hair and red eyes and was too handsome for the young Rita to feel comfortable approaching, but he called her his little bird and taught her what a kiss was. Eventually, the night to consummate their marriage arrived. Her underwear was torn off and he rolled the little buds on her chest around with his tongue, making her feel embarrassed. "Your body and heart are both pure, but you have the potential to be lewd, my wife." He used his tongue and fingers to stroke her entire body with love...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Caged Bride and Her Ice Prince
title.native: 鳥籠花嫁～冷徹皇太子の寵愛教育～
title.romaji: Torikago Hanayome: Reitetsu Koutaishi no Chouai Kyouiku

217379.description:
Alex is a replacement for Sebastian's crush, Eddie. He seems totally smitten with Sebastian, but really it's all an act. He's only using him for money. When Eddie is back in town and moves into Sebastian's place, the first thing he says to Alex is, "Leave Sebastian for me."

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.
synonyms: Fall in Love With the Substitute

217382.description:
Jiang Chen, master of fanfiction, transmigrates into a book and becomes the senior brother of the protagonist, Wen Lingyun. It's alright! This senior brother is just a villainous supporting character, betrayed Wen Lingyun, and died a tragic death... But why! The book he transmigrated into isn't even the original novel, but a lewd fanfiction he drew himself, complete with all the pixelated details?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: The Bad Big Brother Survival Guide
The Vicious Senior Brother's Survival Guide

217383.description:
Ling Qi, a human exuding an alluring aura, infiltrates an agent academy teeming with orcs to seek revenge. At first, he’s relieved to have a clueless partner who shields him from the advances of his orc classmates. Little does he know, however, that the most dangerous orc is the very partner right beside him. The fragile harmony and understanding they barely manage to maintain during the day become precarious as desire grows stronger at night.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

217385.description:
"What's going on here? Let's find out." A cold-hearted emperor-elect and a princess disguised as a maid. The princess who has no choice but to become a concubine...?

"This still isn't enough stimulus." His caresses became more intense. She is extremely embarrassed, but the aphrodisiac makes her body overreact... As a sign of the subjugated nation's allegiance, Princess Lisette of the kingdom of Couronne is offered up to become a concubine to the 60-year-old emperor. However, when she arrives at the empire, the emperor has already passed away. For the sake of her country, Lisette wishes to become the concubine of the next emperor, Victor, but is rejected. So she disguises herself as a maid to get to know him, but is tricked by a nobleman and given an aphrodisiac. When Victor finds out, he offers to soothe the itch inside her!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

"Can you promise me that I'm the only man who can touch you like this?"

How did things end up like this? All I wanted was to know if he was my soulmate! After seeing the happiness of her engaged friend, Sophie, the daughter of a marquis, decided to find love herself. Her fortune said that her soulmate was a "generous and tolerant older knight," but this was all orchestrated by Alec, the second prince and vice captain of the Royal Knights, who wanted to marry Sophie. Having grown up with Alec, Sophie thought he was more like a sibling than a love interest... but she relies on him and ends up asking him to show her his naked body. Then Alec tells her it's her turn to get naked...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

"How much do you know about what married couples do? We will be joined at the deepest parts of you..." The emperor teaches his young wife just how deep his love is.

The young emperor of a neighboring country, Lullant, suddenly proposes to the young marquis's daughter, Felice. Why would the new emperor, who is so powerful, want someone he has never met? He says that he met her once five years ago and has been in love with her ever since. "I won't go all the way until you love me back." Lullant doesn't hide his strong desire, but he is considerate of the inexperienced Felice. He cherishes her and opens up her heart and body until Felice finally realizes her love for him. "It's the night I've been waiting so long for. Could you get any wetter than this?" On the night of their wedding, Felice is given a deep kiss on her bare skin, and she is filled with happiness and anxiety...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

217390.description:
Ji-Eum learns that Seung-Jo, whom she’s had a crush on since high school, has a girlfriend. Desperate to pour out her heartache to someone, she stumbles upon a chat app called Thump-Thump Planet and meets “Jemulpo Gangju,” with whom she spends a brief escape from reality. Then, after winter break, she returns to school for the first time in a while.

“Wait a minute. Why is that person here?!”

There, she comes face to face with “Jemulpo Gangju,” whom she thought she’d never see again…?

“Found you, Dolmengi.”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

217392.description:
Yoshimi’s third resurrection. Following volume five of the series, “Mimi-uri Shoujo/Noroi wo Anata ni" and volume 14, “Kikeiji/Hikigaeru Shoujo," this is the third reissue in the Yoshimi series!

This volume features “Shoujo Isshun-boushi," a story that depicts the bond between sisters torn apart by fate and relentlessly, unjustly tormented—a work that stands out among Yoshimi’s many horror stories for its uniquely refreshing and uplifting aftertaste. Second is "Namakuji Shoujo," which breaks free from the stereotype of rental-book horror heroines—who all too often end up at the mercy of supernatural forces. It features a girl who uses her wits to resolutely confront supernatural monsters, offering a truly heartening sight!

(Source: Mandarake, translated)
