217395.description:
“When the real and the fake meet, can love become real?”

It had been two years since I started living as a fake rich person. I’d rather be envied for being rich than looked down on for being poor. It was a lie that would be fine as long as I didn’t get caught. But, of all people, a boy who seemed capable of seeing right through that lie ended up sitting behind me. Overwhelming wealth, overwhelming indifference. Sin Jae-Eon, the grandson of a real chaebol family. She had planned to use him as a shield. But at some point, he stopped being a shield and became a source of warmth.

“I really like you, Lee Ji-Seo. I like you.”

The straightforward confession of a boy who has nothing to gain and nothing to lose. And a girl who’s afraid to even open her heart, not knowing when it will all be exposed. How long can I, the fake one, hold out in front of him, the real one? Before the first season passes, what will the two of them become to each other?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

217396.description:
The "panic-in-closed-village horror" manga is set in a village named Habaki, which has a strange custom that grants the head of the village supreme authority. The story centers on Akira Sasaki, the second son of the family that leads the village. In the coming new year, Akira's older brother, the eldest son Hikaru, will undergo the ceremony that will make him the next village chief. Akira decides to use the ceremony as an opportunity to ask his childhood friend and crush Kotori Karino to leave the village with him. Meanwhile, in the mountain neighboring Habaki, two men go missing. The village remains preoccupied with preparations for the ceremony. On the day of the ceremony, Hikaru takes the mask signifying his ascent as village chief, and prepares to make his speech, when a strange creature appears.

(Source: Anime News Network)

217397.description:
Eld Elflame, a witch who descended to Earth to save the demon world from crisis, is skilled at making soup and plots to annihilate humanity with her ultimate "poisoned soup." However, she accidentally tastes soup from the human world and is captivated by its otherworldly deliciousness!? A full-fledged cooking fantasy!

(Source: Shonen Gahosha, translated)

217398.description:
Kim Mi-Yeong, a single woman in her mid-thirties, was enjoying a comfortable, carefree single life when she suddenly felt left behind by the news of her friends’ weddings. Filled with a sense of crisis that she might end up dying alone if things continued this way, Mi-Yeong sets out to find a husband, trying everything from dating apps and blind dates to clubs and matchmaking agencies. However, opportunities to meet new men are few and far between, and when she does manage to meet someone, she tends to notice their flaws first. Yet she can’t bring herself to compromise easily just for the sake of marriage.

“Will I ever meet a good man to marry?”
“But what exactly is a ‘good man’?”
“How do I want to live my life?”

Amid countless questions about marriage, this is the story of her journey to find the ending that’s right for her.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

217399.description:
Yu Ji-An, codenamed [Sev], an S-class agent of “Lest,” a top-secret government-run assassin organization. As the youngest agent to successfully complete 300 missions, he finally achieves his long-awaited retirement. Ji-An is finally able to carry out the modest “healing bucket list” he has been preparing for 20 years. His first item on the healing list after retirement: Earn money through legitimate means without killing anyone.

“Boss, I can start working at a convenience store right away. I’m the kind of person who always completes the tasks assigned to me.”

However, contrary to his desire to live quietly while fulfilling this utterly ordinary dream, unpredictable incidents and a suspicious woman keep getting in his way. An assassin’s second life, fraught with hardship and adversity. Will S-class killer Yu Ji-An be able to achieve ordinary happiness without getting his hands dirty?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

I stumbled upon a pair of incredibly erotic panties on the balcony, clearly belonging to the sexy housewife next door. In a display of earnest diligence, I returned them to her. It seems she started wearing such things out of jealousy over her husband’s affair with a younger woman, which, in a way, is cute. Thinking, "She should be with me instead...!" I ended up pinning her down. Caught in a tug-of-war between the assumption that she was definitely making a move and the possibility that she actually was, we ultimately found ourselves passionately desiring one another. Her body was even more erotic than the panties themselves. She was a pro at titty-fucking, making me realize just how foolish those guys are who chase only after youth.

Set in near-future Japan, this is the story of Kairi and his friends as they battle it out to reach the top of "Dark Machine," a globally popular esports competition!

(Source: Jitsugyou no Nihonsha, translated)

217423.description:
The manga centers on Konta, once a promising athlete in competitive swimming. In a past beach trip, he tried to save a girl from drowning. Though his efforts saved the girl's life, the girl remained comatose. Feeling guilty for his own perceived failure, Konta stepped away from swimming. Five years later, Konta has become a shut-in and a shadow of his former self. Unable to stand what has become to him, Konta's older sister suggests he become a swim coach to Shikinomori, a high school known for its competitive swim team. Though not really motivated, Konta heads to the job, and there he finds the girl he saved five years ago.

(Source: Anime News Network)

217428.description:
Young, wealthy, and extremely suspicious—from the moment he set foot in the quiet naval city, Jin Haerok had people groveling at his feet left and right. Lieutenant Seon Yulhui, however, has standards. Some might call her a model policewoman, while others would say that she’s a rigid stickler for the rules. So when he waltzes into her life just to flirt with her, every instinct tells Yulhui to stay away from that man. But what happens when she is left with no choice but to walk right into his bed in order to save a fellow policeman?

(Source: Lezhin US)

217429.description:
For four long years, Yun Sohyeon endured the humiliation of being neglected by her husband, King Yeongchin Mun Gukhyeon, the realm’s feared warlord. Left untouched while treated lower than his concubines, she assumed he despised her. But when Gukhyeon returns from war and demands her bed, Sohyeon braces for heartbreak. Instead, she is met with intense, long-suppressed passion from a husband who has secretly pined for her all along.

(Source: Lezhin US)

217430.description:
What would my two masters have done? “Don’t ask questions. Don’t bother with reasons. Just smash their heads in.” “True chivalry lies in leaving even the slightest measure of mercy.” Cheon Woo-jin, the shared disciple raised by two peerless eccentrics representing the Black and White factions, takes up the Wol-a-bong and Hak-u-seon and sets out to subdue the martial world of the Central Plains with overwhelming strength. This is the tale of the hidden dragon Cheon Woo-jin as he roams the jianghu, seeking to prevent the return of the great evil known as the Dark Heavenly Lord.

(Source: Naver, translated)

217440.description:
Hashi Sarnan is the orphaned son of a ministerial family and lives under the protection of his guardian, his uncle Kiiya. He loves ancient temples and, while working on their restoration, he heard the voice of the sky god Teselan in a dream, and upon waking, the blueprints for the temple were imprinted in his mind.

One day, in the old town market, he almost has his wallet stolen by a pickpocket named Shirato. Later, he hides Shirato, who has killed a white man and his ex-wife and fled to the temple, but Shirato, whose conscience has awakened while helping Cernan with the temple's restoration work, is shot and killed by police officers who deliberately pursued him. Witnessing this, Cernan begins to doubt the way his uncles are promoting the modernization of the country through coffee cultivation, and he seeks the advice of Iwanaga, a Japanese economic advisor to the government, and proceeds to cultivate wheat independently. Meanwhile, in order to build a road that will connect the trading port and the capital in a straight line, he tries to acquire the land belonging to the Colors family between them and the capital, and he works with his uncle to arrange a political marriage between his cousin Arsha and the Colors family.

As Sarnan becomes engrossed in political infighting, he gradually loses his sense of the Sky God's presence. But what exactly is the Sky God, and what is truly necessary to enrich the nation?

217447.description:
The "thrilling tag-team battle" manga features youkai and humans teaming up together. The story centers on Jin Narumi, a second-year middle school student who can see monsters, youkai, devils, and ghosts. He visits his friend Hinata, who lives at a temple, every morning, as Hinata's temple is overrun by these creatures. However, Hinata cannot see them, and so she does not take Jin's worries seriously. One day, Jin and Hinata are attacked by a giant youkai. When Hinata is knocked unconscious and Jin is on the verge of death, Hinata's temple cat Leo appears and turns into a raijuu beast. Together, Jin and Leo team up to take down the giant youkai and save Hinata.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

217448.description:
This is an interrogation room. The atmosphere is tense as questioning takes place to uncover the truth behind a crime. But for some reason, a wonderful aroma fills the air—!? Detective Kunimura Mitsuki, who loves delicious food, has a 100% confession rate among criminals who eat his home-cooked meals! The home-cooking detective solves cases with delicious food! A gourmet comedy with a strong detective drama flavor!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

217449.description:
A girl on the run takes to the skies!

Within an island floating in the sky, there is an underground village of elderly people and one child—Kafka. The adults have taken care of the girl and asked for a single thing in return: She must never leave the village. When her grandfather was alive, that wasn’t a problem. But after he passed away, her days became dull, and the village feels stifling. Inspired by her grandfather’s stories of his adventures around the globe, Kafka longs to experience the outside world for herself. When a visitor from the surface tells her about life beyond the village, Kafka can’t take it anymore. Her only way out is her grandfather’s old plane. Never mind that she hasn’t flown one before! After everything her grandfather taught her, how hard could it be? Join Kafka’s journey as she broadens her horizons, makes friends her own age, and finally learns the sad truth about why her village was cut off from the rest of the world.

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Winner of the 31st Dengeki Novel Prize New Literary Award.
synonyms: Kafka's Journey: Whenever We Set Out, The Sky is Always at Dawn.

217450.description:
The imperial princess Ariadne has lied, cheated, poisoned, and even killed at the behest of the cunning Prince Siegbert. Little does she know, the prince thinks of her as no more than a pawn. He sells her down the river, and she is sentenced to death for her crimes. Just as the reaper’s scythe drops, she closes her eyes and realizes what a fool she’s been, only to wake up and find she has traveled back in time to when she was fifteen. With her second shot at life, she vows to punish the wily prince and set her story back on the right track.

(Source: Yen Press)

Guri-chan, the 105-year-old daughter of the Grim Reaper, is still a child at heart, but she wants the Grim Reaper's scythe. To prove she's a full-fledged Grim Reaper, she visits a 30-something man on the death list who loves American hot dogs. Saving his soul is her first job!

Exile? -- That's what I want! After her engagement is broken off, the villainess Misery is sentenced to exile. But instead of being depressed, she's overjoyed! Together with her beloved cat, Ohagi, she summons a camper van with her skills and sets off on a carefree journey. She gazes at beautiful scenery, savors delicious food along the way, and sometimes even has unexpected encounters!? What will Misery find on her journey, unbound by anyone? An otherworldly camper van life enjoyed with her beloved cat, starting from an exile!

(Source: Mangabox, translated)

217461.description:
Albina is forced to spend her wedding night alone after her husband declares, "I don't consider you my wife, and I don't love you." To make matters worse, after this humiliating treatment, her husband reveals that he is having an affair with her sister and is truly in love with her. Devastated by this revelation, she resolves to take revenge on her husband and sister, so that they will also experience despair! "Those fools who trampled on my heart deserve to be punished." With her vow of revenge, she carefully and steadily begins to draw up a scenario leading to their downfall...!? A vivid and beautiful revenge drama where various emotions intertwine, now in a shocking comic adaptation!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

217462.description:
Millie, rumored to be a cold and aloof princess who keeps others at a distance, is suddenly called the "final boss" by Angelina, who calls herself the "villainess," and is killed without understanding why. However, when she wakes up, she finds herself rewound to the world three years before she was killed. Millie vows revenge for her unjust death. But she might be killed again if she's alone... Thinking this, she decides to make "friends" who will help her, and tries to act more sociably than in her first life. However, Millie, who has lived alone her whole life, has a clumsy approach that backfires every time! Eventually, it develops into a huge commotion that involves everyone around her—!? A comedy fantasy about a clumsy young lady's second chance at life, starting with revenge, begins!!

(Source: Mangabox, translated)

After graduating from middle school, Kurumi Kobashiri has to move to Hokkaido because of her family situation. When she tells her boyfriend that they will have to be in a long-distance relationship, he declares he doesn’t want to continue their relationship anymore. Heartbroken after the traumatic breakup, Kurumi wanders aimlessly outside and finds herself at an ice skating rink, where she meets a good-looking guy and discovers the world of ice hockey.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

217479.description:
From the author of "Twin Games" comes the long-awaited new series!! In a certain city, a dry cleaner stands in a dilapidated shopping district. The young people working at the storefront have a "side job." It's a business of robbery targeting criminals...!? What will these young people, who have been cast out of the framework of society, grasp at the end of their spiral of karma? An outcast crime action story that takes place in the underworld where villains run rampant!!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

217480.description:
Naruse, a strong delinquent, admires his first love, Kuga, who saved him from bullies when he was a child. Six years later, he enrolled into the same school as Kuga, but when they met again, Kuga had become a shadow of his former self. Naruse believes that he's still the Kuga he fell in love with, so he's determined to confess his feelings before graduation. While immersing himself in his beloved music, he somehow rose in status to become a count's son! Determined to enjoy music to the fullest, he used knowledge from his past life to amass wealth and gather fellow musicians. Then, one day, he met Julietta, a duke's daughter feared as a "monster"... but to him, she looked like an absolute beauty. What is going on with this world?!

217770.description:
Suzuki works at Fuma Home Inc., a real estate company. He decides to quit after suffering through its toxic work environment, being harassed by superiors, and forced to work illegal hours. His resignation is accepted, but he is only allowed to leave the company after 3 months. From the next day, his boss starts treating him like trash and the president tricks Suzuki into making a mistake that causes him to be held liable for the damages. When Suzuki is feeling devastated, he meets a woman named Shizuka. She claims to work for a "Company Demolition Agency" and tells him that she will destroy the toxic company on his behalf. What will Suzuki do?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

217771.description:
This is a town where gods, shrines, and "those who pray" gather. When people are troubled, sad, or have a strong desire for something, they all go to offer their "wishes" to the gods. A mysterious orb and a mysterious man weave "feelings" together in this bizarre, intricate, and fantastical tale that begins now!

(Source: Shonen Gahosha, translated)

217773.description:
Born into a prestigious family of mages, young Lyle was hailed as a prodigy thanks to his overwhelming magical power. But when it’s discovered that the only spells he can use are Lifestyle Magic—simple magic for chores, cooking, and farming, he’s cast out of his home. Determined not to give up, Lyle sets out on a new path: to become the world’s greatest support mage and make his mark as an adventurer! This is the story of a self-proclaimed support role who unknowingly becomes unrivaled, with the limitless potential of Lifestyle Magic.

(Source: Earth Star Entertainment)

217774.description:
“Was sleeping with me... a mistake?”

Ji-wan, a college student returning after military service, ends up having an impulsive one-night stand with Seo-ah, a woman eight years his senior whom he met while out drinking. With her neat face and glasses, she seemed like a flawless professional. But in bed… She became a completely different woman. Ji-wan is completely captivated by her, but he's left with one question: We slept together, so why is she acting like nothing happened? To top it off, it turns out Seo-ah lives right next door. As the two keep bumping into each other, their dangerous nights repeat. The more they meet, the more Ji-wan falls for her body and soul, but Seo-ah just seems to think of him as a cute younger guy... And to top it all off, an older rival appears, thirsting after Seo-ah! It started as a one-night stand, but one night is no longer enough for Ji-wan.

“Can't you see me as a man by now?”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: I Shouldn't Have Slept With You

217775.description:
A woman suddenly receives a notification confirming that her marriage has been officially registered—even though she has no idea who her husband is. Growing up, her grandfather often joked about marrying her into the family of his closest friend, but she thought those plans had long been forgotten. Now, she discovers that she drunkenly slept with that family's second son. To make matters worse, they somehow ended up legally married! How is she supposed to deal with this unexpected marriage?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

217776.description:
One day, a mysterious hypnosis begins without warning on an unspecified number of people. The targets, locations, and situations are unpredictable! The moment reason is paralyzed and suppressed instincts awaken, the secret lives of these ordinary people crumble. A thrilling and steamy relay of escapades unfolded by new characters in every episode.

The year is 2025—dungeons suddenly started popping up all over the world. A young man, Hiroshi Nagano, ventures into one of them, but ends up trapped in the dungeon’s uncharted depths…for 25 years! By devouring ferocious monsters, he not only survives, but builds a legendary physique. When he finally makes it back to the surface, he’s greeted to a Japan of the future, where streaming your dungeon exploration is mandatory. His overwhelming power is broadcast to the nation, propelling him straight into the ranks of top dungeon explorers! Using a quarter-century of brutal survival instincts, a shady-looking veteran is about to dominate the algorithm in this thrilling, over-the-top heroic dungeon tale!

(Source: Manga UP!)

Although exiled to the frontier, she begins a carefree second life in a comfortable detached palace, lacking for nothing. Using her memories from her previous life and her quick wit, she tackles land reforms and solves local problems, earning the love and trust of the people. In a medieval fantasy world, a boy named Ian is reincarnated as the son of an ordinary farmer. But this medieval fantasy world is far more complicated than it seems! He shudders at its outrageous standards of hygiene and grows angry at the unfathomable selfishness of people. 217833.description:
Seoul has been devastated by the Howling Plague, a mysterious disease that transforms humans into monstrous beasts. Amid the chaos lives Rir, an unusually perceptive boy struggling to survive while caring for his sick younger sibling—the only family he has left. But when a mysterious incident erupts at the hospital, Rir's desperate attempt to protect his sibling changes him forever. He awakens caught somewhere between human and beast, forced to confront the very plague that has destroyed their world. With everything he has left, Rir makes a promise: "I'll bring you back. No matter what. Even if I have to become a beast myself."

(Source: Naver, translated)

217834.description:
Today again, Lady Kyrania fails to notice His Majesty's feelings…?

Despite being the daughter of a count, Kyrania is forced to take a job as a maid in the royal palace to help support her family, which is drowning in debt.

Amid her busy daily life, her favorite way to unwind is taking a snack break in a secluded garden. One day, she goes to her usual spot with some cookies, only to find a civil official collapsed from hunger! She quickly gives him some sugar, bringing him back to his senses, and he is extremely grateful.

Determined to repay her kindness, the two begin meeting during their breaks from that day onward…

Yeon-Ho Seo returns home for the holidays, only to find a younger brother who never existed before. But everyone insists Nan-Hwa has always been part of the family, leaving Yeon-Ho alone in his doubts. As his strange "little brother" draws closer, Yeon-Ho begins to question his own reality.

(Source: Manta)

217843.description:
“If you don’t like cooking, I’ll even resort to using my good looks.”

Chef Han I-Deun, a world-renowned master of fine dining, has come all the way to a pottery workshop deep in the mountains and is being stubborn. He has only one goal: to obtain a piece from “Cheongsoyo,” one of the five great pottery workshops. But he’s up against Hwang Ja-Yeong, a mountain woman who locks the door the moment things go wrong. His confident pitch was rebuffed before he could even give a presentation, but this city man, who never gives up, refuses to go away and shows up again to strike up a conversation.

“Just say ‘yes.’ That’s the right answer; everything else is wrong.”

But...

He has a delicate body and pale skin. His golden hair, swaying in the wind, is soft and gentle.

He's like the wolf that has jumped out of my favorite picture book—

Iroha, a gentle girl as calm as a sheep, and Manshiro Arano, a delinquent boy known as a lonely lone wolf -

A writer struggles to tell his stories. Since his work "The Orange Scarf," he fails to impress his readers, and he falls into a deep slump. Despite his constant rejections of all interviews, one interviewer appears who knows about his unpublished work "A Hungarian Photographer", and he agrees to an interview. Thirsty for an honest opinion about his work, he negotiates a deal with the interviewer, one interview for his honest opinions about his other works. As he tells his story, the stories reveal secrets about a man never disclosed to the public.

(Source: Tapas)

217856.description:
Oda Gentoku, a handyman who runs a small “odd-jobs” shop in town, lived a carefree life while proudly declaring he would stay single forever. But one day, while working on an electrical repair job, he’s unexpectedly electrocuted and wakes up in another world! This is the story of a middle-aged man who remains steadfastly single, takes up his craftsman trade once again, and enjoys a free and easy life in another world.

(Source: Mangabox, translated)

title.native: 独身おじさんの異世界ライフ～結婚しません、フリーな独身こそ最高です～

217857.description:
Azusa is a newlywed, married for six months to her husband Sogo, who works at a major company. Her blissful life is shattered when her stepsister Erika moves in. Using her feminine wiles, Erika systematically steals everything from Azusa: her husband, her home, and her peace of mind. Azusa loses everything and is taken in by her cold but capable boss, Nanase, a man she used to be wary of. This begins her story of revenge and new love as she fights to reclaim her life from the sister who has always taken everything from her.

(Source: Beaglee, translated)

title.native: この男、優良物件につき ～クレクレ義妹が私のすべてを奪ってきます～
title.romaji: Kono Otoko, Yuuryou Bukken ni Tsuki: Kurekure Imouto ga Watashi no Subete wo Ubatte Kimasu

217858.description:
Reporter Rei Kurisu, eight years into this career without a single scoop to show for it, was starting to sweat a bit. So, when a tip comes in that the home where the famously unsolved K City Family Murder took place is soon to be torn down, Rei immediately sets out to investigate. But this house may hold more secrets than ever expected. It starts with a single peculiar photograph, and the further Rei probes, the more hidden truths and pieces of the victims' shocking past come to light.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

217859.description:
Artie, the second son of a viscount family with a reputation as a "womanizer and dissolute," is to marry Giselle, the daughter of a prestigious marquis family and former crown princess. After being divorced by the crown prince unilaterally, Giselle, who now governs her family's marquisate, needs to produce an heir to the marquisate, and therefore desires a new "husband"—specifically, a "man with plenty of experience who can quickly impregnate women."

"Would you marry me with the intention of having children?" Artie readily accepts her proposal and becomes her husband, but from the very first day of their marriage, he is taken aback by Giselle's workaholic and overly strict and ascetic demeanor. He faces their wedding night with apprehension about their future married life, but his eyes are captivated by Giselle's daring nightgown and alluring figure as she awaits him in the bedroom. And then, "'Marriage of husband and wife' is a duty necessary for the survival of the family and the nation. It is something that must be endured and done diligently." Her attitude, showing such ignorance of "pleasure" despite having been married before , caused his reason to crumble. "I will teach you everything you couldn't do with the Crown Prince (your ex-husband). I will teach you how to have pleasurable lovemaking so that Giselle can conceive my child."

A dissolute nobleman and a strict former crown princess. The two's "duty to make a baby" will not end until morning today either──…

Everyone's talking about Dungeon Tube, the hottest app for streaming dungeon adventures. Yamato's classmates can't stop bragging about their streams, but he just doesn't see what all the fuss is about. Then again, that's hardly surprising—his own house is a dungeon! On a whim, Yamato decides to give Dungeon Tube a try... only to discover that his home is actually the world's toughest dungeon?! And so, his exciting dungeon-streaming life begins—right from home!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

In a kingdom where witches are burned at the stake, Alice Liberance has spent her life fearing the day her family might be condemned. Just before her wedding to Oscar, her worst nightmare comes true when she awakens as a witch. She flees and hides, then gives birth to their son, Noah, while Oscar believes she’s dead. Years later, they are finally reunited, but Alice fears that her curse will put the family she loves in danger. Will they ever be able to live out the future they dream of, or will they have to say farewell forever?

Latisse Eldwin, the so-called “Puppet Princess” of the Zerdian Empire, is used to being used by her father for her healing powers, her stepmother and half-siblings as a scapegoat, and the citizens as an object of scorn. But after a mysterious young man slaughters everyone in the palace, she suddenly finds herself in a position of great power… and having to choose a husband from between three men. Her decision could turn the entire world upside down… but who is the correct choice?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ludek, a nation that possessed immense wealth and unparalleled military power, was destroyed. Roa, a young man who was an ordinary civil servant in that nation, miraculously survived, but he grew older burdened by guilt for abandoning his friends and surviving alone. But one day, he wakes up to find himself two years before his homeland's destruction! To prevent the downfall of his country and protect his comrades, the civil servant becomes a strategist, using his memories and the experience he gained in the future as his weapons, and confronts the fate of destruction! A rags-to-riches war tale of a former ordinary civil servant!!

This story is a fictional manga that is as close to non-fiction as possible, brought to you by Kobayashi Doumu, who is also the chief assistant to "Kasane"! It is full of "over the top" dishes, such as a super-sized katsudon with slices as thick as a smartphone and roast beef cooked at a low temperature in a bathroom! You can also catch a glimpse of the little-known behind-the-scenes stories of manga production, making it a must-read for "Kasane" fans!

On the day of the grand opening of the love hotel he inherited from his father, owner Riki Takada wakes up to find himself transported to another world along with the entire love hotel. And it's on the grounds of a kingdom!? Confused, he gives a tour of the love hotel to a female captain who comes on patrol...and somehow ends up giving her her first experience of adult XXX. 217893.description:
In an alternative timeline where the samurai didn't disappear after the Meiji Restoration, a rising tide of ghosts—commonly called samurai spirits—assails modern-day Shinjuku, Tokyo. These spirits frequently possess the bodies of the living and then go on rampages. The young lord Teruie, whose domain is Shinjuku, sets out to battle the spirits at the request of his classmate and subject, Mijuu, however... This is the start of a historical modern-day drama that follows the journey of a young feudal lord living in the present!

(Source: Comic Walker, translated)

217894.description:
Guy Gullveig was once bullied by his half-brother for being an illegitimate child. Eventually, he was taken in by his grandfather, a former adventurer living deep in the mountains. He prescribed "swinging the sword" to Guy as a way to heal both his body and mind. Even after his grandfather's death, Guy continued to practice 10,000 swings every single day, eventually reaching middle age. One day, Guy decides to go to the city to become an adventurer, following his late grandfather's advice. But what Guy did not know is that those years of practice swings have turned him into the strongest swordsman alive!! From the Sword Saint Altina to the guild receptionist Lilina and the feudal Lady Celis, the people Guy helps out of the kindness of his heart begin to realize how strong he actually is. This is an "unconscious unrivaled" fantasy story about an old adventurer who worked a little too hard on his daily 10,000 swings and now strikes down the strongest with his perfected blade!!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

217902.description:
Vera, who started out as a beggar, has no qualms about trampling on others or making despicable deals just to survive. Even in an era when the Demon King had emerged, he did not fight like a hero; instead, he hid in the deepest darkness, concerned only with preserving his own life. Though he managed to survive in the end, what awaited him upon his return after the war was karma. As he lay consumed by the curse, waiting for death, Vera did not even hope for anyone to be by his side at the end of his life, assuming no one would be there. However, when he opened her eyes, he found himself in a cesspool—and there, alongside him, was the blind saint Renée, who had been declared dead. Though René had a humble appearance, blind and covered in burn scars, she took Vera in with a heart more kind and selfless than anyone else’s. But she eventually died, and Vera was unable to prevent it. After his rebirth, he vows that this time, he will be the one to seek her out first and protect her at all costs. However, protecting René is not something that can be achieved simply by becoming stronger. On the day the Saint’s Stigmata manifest, the entire continent—from the Holy Kingdom and the Empire to the Kingdom Alliance, the Dragonians, and even the Followers of the Night—begins to mobilize around her.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Han Gitae, a college student who becomes a "fake priest" at a church after being offered a high-paying part-time job, finds himself hearing sacred confessions from the other side of the confessional wall.

A single grimoire found in an old bookshop changed his life forever. A college student forms a contract with an invisible vampire that tears people apart and kills them. Hiding his true identity, he must grow into a mage in this modern occult coming-of-age fantasy.

217944.description:
Babel Tower Tokyo is a super-high-rise apartment complex where a person's social standing is determined by the floor they live on—a twisted hierarchy deeply rooted in the building. This opulent, enviable luxury complex suddenly transforms into a hellish place where mysterious, monstrous creatures devour people. Can Takuya Kijima, a young man with neither education nor money, protect himself from the life-eating monsters and the money-hungry inhabitants? A tower apartment escape survival story!!

(Source: Comic Zenon, translated)

Somewhere in Japan, there's a quiet spot that soothes people. It's called "Ear Cleaning Specialty Shop Nagomiya" The gal-type employee working there, Aiki, loves ear cleaning more than anything! With her beaming smile and meticulous ear cleaning, you're sure to be transported to the ultimate state of relaxation before you know it. This is a shop you'll want to visit again and again.

There, she coincidentally meets the author, Hiyori, and they hit it off. Asuka is introduced to a man named Merio and visits their base, but what she witnesses there is a shocking reality... He's usually sharp-tongued and hangs out with scary people, but in reality, he's a highly skilled lawyer with a strong sense of compassion who even conducts background checks for his clients! Ichiko Igarashi works for a major trading company and is a top performer in the second sales section in order to fulfill her dream of becoming a professional woman. She has been in a five-year relationship with her boyfriend, who works in the same section, and she thinks she is sailing smoothly in both her personal and professional life, but then, unexpectedly, she gets her heart broken! "I can't stand to be around a perfect guy like you...I was rejected because I'm better at my job than my boyfriend?" Stunned and burnt out, I was drunk in a park when a man who happened to be sitting next to me took me into his arms. He was gentle and kind, and he healed her, and she decided to forget about her ex-boyfriend and get on with her work. The next day, Ichiko's sales performance is recognized and she is transferred to the Sales Section 1, the most profitable section in the company! Ichiko is delighted, but the section chief is rumored to be a very strict and devilish boss. She goes to greet him, but is surprised to meet a man in a park...?

217982.description:
Haram, who spent his entire life in an orphanage, lost all hope of adoption after a trait test indicated a high probability of him being an Omega. However, as if by a twist of fate, he was chosen by twins who happened to visit the orphanage and adopted into a loving family. Although the adoption was arranged to find him as a mate for the dominant Alpha twins, he enjoyed happy days under kind parents. Yet, as decades passed without him manifesting as an Omega, Haram grew increasingly anxious that he might be kicked out of the house. Then, suddenly, the twins experienced their first rut...

With her subtle body piercings and cigarette-smoking style, Fuwa Ryouka is suitably nicknamed Delinquent-chan.

A direct hit to the brain, a shock to the five senses. A complete collection of all past one-shot works.

From the origin to the present—a collection of exquisite violence-action short stories that traces the evolution of Yashiro Manabu, creator of "TANK CHAIR"! Also includes the brand new one-shot "Murahagane - Section Chief Kunboku's Conditions as a Boss"!

217987.description:
Johnman, once a member of the world’s strongest adventurer group, Alibaba’s 40 Thieves, has now grown older and decides to return to his hometown, dreaming of a peaceful slow life. However, just when he thinks a calm retirement awaits, a massive band of thieves suddenly attacks the town! When Johnman steps in to save everyone and defeats them, his heroic deeds spread all the way to the royal capital—and before he knows it, two young girls appear, begging to become his disciples! The peaceful, carefree life he longed for seems to be drifting further and further away… A story of a legendary adventurer’s “second life,” now beautifully adapted into manga!

217988.description:
Alf, the eldest son of the prestigious Sword Emperor family—known for producing generations of warriors blessed with powerful skills—was expected to inherit greatness. However, unlike his talented younger brother who received an excellent skill, Alf was given a seemingly useless one: 《∞ Cheat Ability》, a mysterious “failure skill” with no apparent power. Branded as a disgrace to the family, he was cast out and decided to live as an adventurer in a distant village. On his way there, he encounters a princess being attacked by a suspicious group. Though he tries to save her, the enemy is far too strong—and Alf faces certain death. But just when all seems lost, his so-called “useless” skill begins to awaken…!?

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

An era where Awakened Ones and Hunters thrive. Recruiting everyone from orcs to top-tier workers, Ha-Jun builds his own “auto-hunting” team. While Ha-Jun continues to expand his operations while hiding his true identity, his presence gradually begins to attract the attention of the nation’s top hunters and powerful foreign powers...!

"Notice already, Ms. Oblivious... I've already completely fallen for you." Koharu is a plain-looking office worker with low self-esteem that stems from not having any romantic experience. But she has a secret she cannot tell anyone... She has a friend with benefits, Sakuya, who obviously has a dangerous vibe about him. "Let me hold you. Come here. You're so cute." "I'm the only one who knows how dirty you are. I love that." Koharu's body melts into his... Koharu tells herself she needs to end this relationship, but she may be the only one thinking that...?
